verdict.rationale: CoreWeave offers some built-in ways to act on many resources at once. Node Pools apply a shared configuration (labels, taints, annotations) to any number of Nodes and scale as a group via the Cluster Autoscaler. Bucket lifecycle policies (Expiration, NoncurrentVersionExpiration, AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload) act on objects in bulk, and the Terraform provider manages many resources declaratively. However, nothing documents a general bulk-operation or batch API for acting across arbitrary items at once. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk API or console bulk actions (e.g., multi-select delete/update), documentation of bulk object or resource operations beyond lifecycle rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
